_comment: Copy to .claude/spec-workflow.json in your project and edit. All keys are optional; anything omitted is auto-detected from your project's manifest (pyproject.toml / package.json / go.mod / Cargo.toml) or falls back to a built-in default. If no key and no recognized stack supply a runnable test_fast, the autonomous loop safe-disarms. standards_file (the coding-standards doc standards-reviewer applies) is detected from CODING_STANDARDS.md, .claude/docs/coding-standards.md, .claude/docs/coding-standard.md, then CONTRIBUTING.md; null if none exist. It is layered over the plugin's standards/base.md; its frontmatter can set extends (base|none), disable and enforce (base rule ids). The review block is read only by review-assist: a list given here replaces the default list; review_guide is detected from .claude/docs/review-guide.md then REVIEW.md when unset; retro_root defaults to ~/.claude/retro_review.
